shared_elements: monolithic block treated as an anthropomorphic figure with a distinct head/top and body
shallow low-relief motifs applied across the body of an upright pillar-like form
horizontal band or belt-like division crossing the body
small subsidiary figure/motif placed low on the body
justification: Both surfaces are upright, block-like anthropomorphic monoliths whose bodies carry schematic shallow relief organised into stacked zones separated by a horizontal band, and both include an isolated circular disc in relief plus a small subordinate motif low on the body. The decisive difference is content: A's registers are filled with a menagerie of recognisable animals in profile (quadruped, long-necked birds, snake-like forms) and a small human figure, whereas B shows only abstract discs, loops and appendage-like elements with no animals at all.
